headline: Proposed rules for selling and distributing kratom products, plus a tabled change to sick leave terms.
summary: A motion can pass the kratom ordinance and refer it to the Committee on Accounts, Enrollment & Revenue Administration. A motion can also remove the sick leave change from the table.
items: Ordinance regulating sale and distribution of kratom products (Chapter 130, Sections 130.56 to 130.63)
Ordinance changing sick leave use terms (Section 33.081 (D))
item_action_words: a motion is in order that the Ordinance Amendment ought to pass
Tabled on June 2, 2026, at the request of the Human Resources Department.
plain_text:
COMMITTEE ON BILLS ON SECOND READING 
December 1, 2026 Immediately Following HR Committee 
Aldermanic Chambers, City Hall (3rd Floor) 
 
Members: Aldermen Trisciani, Terrio, Fajardo, Kantor, Dexter 
 
AGENDA 
 
The Chairman calls the meeting to order. 
  
The Clerk calls the roll. 
  
1. Ordinance Amendment: 
 
“Amending the Code of Ordinances of the City of Manchester by amending Chapter 
130 to add Sections 130.56 through 130.63 regulating the sale and distribution of 
kratom products.” 
If the Committee so desires, a motion is in order that the Ordinance 
Amendment ought to pass and be referred to the Committee on Accounts, 
Enrollment & Revenue Administration. 
    
TABLED ITEM 
 
(A motion is in order to remove any item from the table.) 
  
2. Ordinance Amendment: 
  
“Amending Section 33.081 Sick Leave (D) of the Code of Ordinances of the City 
of Manchester to change the terms of sick leave use.” 
(Note: Tabled on June 2, 2026, at the request of the Human Resources 
Department.) 
    
If there is no further business, a motion is in order to adjourn.
